/* Distinct alternating soap-base card appearances. Cosmetic image tint only;
   original product photos remain untouched. */
#productsGrid .soap-visual .thumb{position:relative;isolation:isolate;background:#f6f8f5}
#productsGrid .soap-visual .thumb img{position:relative;z-index:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
#productsGrid .soap-visual .thumb:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;mix-blend-mode:multiply;opacity:.33}
#productsGrid .soap-clear .thumb:after,#productsGrid .soap-white .thumb:after{opacity:0}
#productsGrid .soap-rose .thumb:after{background:#f1a4ad}
#productsGrid .soap-green .thumb:after{background:#a7d7a6}
#productsGrid .soap-yellow .thumb:after{background:#f6dc72;opacity:.4}
#productsGrid .soap-purple .thumb:after{background:#c5adee}
#productsGrid .soap-peach .thumb:after{background:#ffc1a1}
#productsGrid .soap-blue .thumb:after{background:#9bd7ee}
#productsGrid .soap-pink .thumb:after{background:#f8a8d3}
#productsGrid .soap-white .thumb{background:#fff}
#productsGrid .soap-clear .thumb{background:#f2faf7}
#productsGrid .soap-yellow .thumb{background:#fff9e5}
#productsGrid .soap-rose .thumb{background:#fff1f2}
#productsGrid .soap-green .thumb{background:#edf8ed}
#productsGrid .soap-purple .thumb{background:#f6efff}
#productsGrid .soap-peach .thumb{background:#fff2e9}
#productsGrid .soap-blue .thumb{background:#ecf8fd}
#productsGrid .soap-pink .thumb{background:#fff0f7}

<style id="hisa-natural-3d-photo-finish">
/* Light studio backdrop, natural shadow and subtle depth for ALL existing product photos. */
.product .thumb, .detail-photo, .hisa-herbal-photo, .hisa-wax-photo,

.hisa-paraffin-photo {

  border-radius:15px;
  box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.88),inset 0 -2px 6px rgba(49,83,41,.035),0 7px 18px rgba(33,69,30,.085);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.product .thumb img, .detail-photo img, .hisa-herbal-photo img,
.hisa-wax-photo img, .hhd-image img, .liquid-bottle-wrap img,
.hisa-candle-image-wrap img, .hisa-paraffin-photo img {
  display:block;
  max-width:100%;

  filter:contrast(1.035) saturate(1.055) brightness(1.012) drop-shadow(0 7px 6px rgba(37,48,31,.12));
  transition:transform .22s ease,filter .22s ease;

}

  transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.018);

 }
}
@media(max-width:600px){
 .product .thumb, .detail-photo, .hisa-herbal-photo, .hisa-wax-photo,

 }

}
